public_definitions: Review the city emissions-reduction dashboard, identify the emissions-reduction program with the largest contribution, then send that program to the accelerated program review queue.
Use the dashboard to determine which city emissions-reduction program is the largest contribution category for this routing decision.

Program routing decision: Route Building retrofits to accelerated program review, Route Transit electrification to accelerated program review, Keep Industrial efficiency in routine program monitoring.
